definition_sql: SELECT work_id FROM works WHERE genre='曲' AND text_raw LIKE '%(%唱)%'
SELECT work_id, text_raw FROM works WHERE genre='曲' -- 再以正则 re.search(r'[（(][^）)]*唱[）)]', text_raw) 过滤

A: 正则 [（(][^）)]*唱[）)] 命中
B: title_raw 含句读[，。；？！、：] 且 length(title_raw)>=17
C: 去掉[（(][^）)]*[）)]后汉字数<12
SET = A ∪ B ∪ C
